seedSource: Four fresh independent Python secrets.randbelow(2**31-1)+1 draws executed 2026-11-12 before any native trial; each seed crossed both candidate physical seats.
policyControl: All arms retain identical v2 owner VIP recipient policy, bilateral Lillie's Determination after-Pass policy, public-hand-six Gengar Horror House tempo, native Mew Ultra Ball root/search and generic actor hand-discard wrapper. Source-specific actorMewUltraBallPaymentGuard and actorMewQuickBallPaymentGuard are explicitly false in every arm so the generic attack-fuel frontier is not mixed with its prohibited source-specific alternative. candidateSeatAllocation: Four fresh original-rank5 source deals crossed with both candidate physical seats A/B; each exact context appears in all three A/B/A arms.
eligibility: Include every preregistered context and seat, including no eligible discard prompt, no attack-fuel opportunity, no Perfection donor, no changed payment, cap, abort, error, incomplete game, or native rejection. No outcome-based exclusion.
primarySuccess: A native accepted mandatory owner discard payment changes only when the generic choice would erase every known one-attachment funding option; record exact physical payment, retained Energy, subsequent real attachment, Perfection/printed attack, damage and Prize receipt, source response, complete native winner, and full physical-zone continuity.
scopeLimit: Eight developmental physical contexts against original rank5 only. This is not a full-field matchup estimate, not an independently paper/clock-qualified game, and cannot establish 99.5%.
